components.name: FFmpeg
components.description: FFmpeg and ffprobe executables, including Jellyfin patches.

components.name: fast-float
components.description: Header-only numeric parser compiled into libplacebo.

components.name: fdk-aac-stripped
components.description: Static stripped FDK AAC library (--enable-libfdk-aac). Streamarr selects the native aac encoder, not libfdk_aac.

components.name: ffnvcodec
components.description: NVIDIA codec API headers and inline loaders; NVIDIA driver/CUDA runtime libraries are not bundled.

components.name: gcc-runtime
components.description: Statically linked GCC 15.2.0 runtime libraries (libgcc/libstdc++), with GCC Runtime Library Exception.

components.name: glad
components.description: Generated OpenGL/EGL loader code compiled into libplacebo; excludes generator-only Python dependencies.

components.name: glibc-startup
components.description: glibc startup/nonshared support from the cross-toolchain; shared glibc libraries and the dynamic loader are supplied by the base system.

components.name: glslang
components.description: Static shader language compiler within shaderc_combined; pin from shaderc DEPS.

components.name: implib
components.description: Generated lazy import-loader code embedded for system libraries; upstream does not pin the generator checkout.

properties.name: streamarr:version-note
properties.value: Upstream clones an unpinned default branch. This revision identifies the notice source, not a proven binary build revision.

components.name: libdrm
components.description: DRM API headers used with generated import shims; system libdrm and GPU drivers are not bundled.

components.name: libne10
components.description: Static ARM NEON dependency of Opus.

components.name: libogg
components.description: Static container dependency of Vorbis and Theora.

components.name: libplacebo
components.description: Static rendering library (--enable-libplacebo), including Jellyfin's builder/patches/libplacebo patches.

components.name: libunibreak
components.description: Static Unicode line-breaking dependency of libass.

components.name: opencl
components.description: OpenCL API headers; vendor OpenCL implementations are not bundled.

components.name: opencl-icd-loader
components.description: Static OpenCL ICD loader (--enable-opencl); loads external vendor implementations.

components.name: openmpt
components.description: Static module decoder (--enable-libopenmpt), including minimp3 and mpt utility code. Uses external zlib/ogg/vorbis; excludes fallback miniz/stb_vorbis and tracker-only components.

components.name: spirv-headers
components.description: SPIR-V headers used by shaderc/glslang/SPIRV-Tools; pin from shaderc DEPS.

components.name: spirv-tools
components.description: Static SPIR-V optimization/validation code within shaderc_combined; pin from shaderc DEPS.

components.name: srt
components.description: Static SRT transport library (--enable-libsrt), including UDT-derived code.

components.name: vulkan-headers
components.description: Vulkan API headers and registry used by libplacebo.

components.name: vulkan-loader
components.description: Static Vulkan shim loader (--enable-vulkan); the system Vulkan loader and drivers are not bundled.

components.name: x265
components.description: Static HEVC encoder (--enable-libx265), including the json11 parser in the enabled HDR10+ builds.

components.name: xz
components.description: Static liblzma compression library (--enable-lzma); xz command-line programs are not bundled.

components.name: gnulib
components.description: Pinned libiconv bootstrap source input; this entry does not assert that the entire gnulib project is linked.
